primary_question: At equal semantic-positive yield, does online-visible temporal evidence geometry consistently improve recovery of independently defined temporal events?

frozen_components.candidate_unit_semantics: one released V3 candidate per 10-second V3 unit
frozen_components.event_relation_evaluator: P0 one-to-one maximum-cardinality then tIoU evaluator; human-reference outcomes also include direct evidence-touch endpoints
frozen_components.materializer: C1_gap_limited: merge consecutive queried relevant units iff temporal gap <= 10 seconds; no duration cap, negative barrier, or K3 extras
frozen_components.budget_semantics: cached semantic-oracle QUERY_BUDGET, not wall-clock time

prohibited: change human event boundaries or query definitions after method results
trace_generator_visibility: candidate order/timestamps and frozen Proxy-A score only; no semantic label, reference event, or human label is read during trace construction

ORACLE_OBSERVED_AFTER_VERIFY: geometry of already verified positive evidence

P1-A_preflight_gate.pass_rule: >=12 exact-yield geometry-varying strata, all three currently available video-query clusters represented, and >=3 strata per video
P1-A_preflight_gate.fail_rule: P1_DESIGN_INSUFFICIENT; do not acquire new human reference under the insufficient design
P1-A_preflight_gate.interpretation: A pass establishes only that the available single-query Proxy-A design can form candidate matched contrasts. It does not establish P1 PASS.

P1_scientific_pass_gate: yield-only is clearly insufficient on independent human data
online-visible geometry gives stable held-out video/query explanatory lift
equal-yield high- vs low-geometry traces show consistent independent human-recovery effects
the effect occurs across multiple independent video-query clusters
two natural proxy families agree directionally
the primary effect does not use reference-only features
P1_no_go_conditions: geometry predicts C1 but not human recovery
effect disappears under second natural proxy
positive yield explains nearly all quality difference

natural_proxy_families: Proxy A: prospective YOLOv8n object/track/motion-oriented proxy
available_scope_at_freeze.known_scope_gap: The released substrate has three video-query clusters, not the requested six, and only one natural proxy family. P1 cannot be scientifically passed from this substrate alone.
